information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png) - [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) is back with another edition of South Bay Weeknight Brain Freeze! - This competition will be held **on a weeknight** without traditional events such as 3x3. - This competition will be occuring on the same night and in the same venue as the Mountain View location of [WCC FMC Leap Day 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCFMCLeapDay2024). This one will begin **after** WCC FMC Leap Day 2024 is finished.
